name: Chip
source: Norse myth 01 DESIGN.md section F2 (22 Nov 2026): Chip unchanged (a copy of potatobrawl/chip.json) + costume key `buds` (engine/page/costumes-norse-chip.js). chip.json is untouched.
personality: Spud's everyday friend with too much energy (Jonny's pick, 12 Nov 2026). The smallest of the group, never stands still, says yes before he has heard the plan and drags Spud into things at full speed. Catchphrase, in gibberish with the same subtitle every time: "Let's go!"
voiceNote: gibberish (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: A copy of potatobrawl/chip.json with the costume key `buds`: 8 potato-eye dimples on bare skin above the rolled hood, the pluck, the plaster, the gold eyes and the flush (costumes-norse-chip.js USAGE). No hat, no weapon, no prop. One garment: the sunny yellow hoodie (costumes-everyday.js), hood down as a thick rolled cowl closing in a V, two white drawstrings, a pouch pocket, ribbed hem and cuffs. Two leaves in a V. Brown trousers, white trainers with one red stripe. A round ball, 0.65 of Spud's height as on his sheet. Same skin, eyes and hands as Spud.
